# Sainte Chapelle Tickets

> > Official ticket booking platform for Sainte Chapelle, the Gothic royal chapel in Paris featuring stunning 13th-century stained glass windows.

This site provides comprehensive visitor information for Sainte Chapelle, the masterpiece commissioned by King Louis IX to house holy relics including the Crown of Thorns. Visitors can book skip-the-line tickets, learn about the chapel's Rayonnant Gothic architecture, and plan their visit to this iconic Paris landmark located within the Palais de la Cité.
